upstream.installation: git checkout plus PYTHONPATH (upstream has no package manifest)

runtime_requirements.cuda: runtime toolkit with nvcc, CUDART/driver/CRT/NVVM development files, gcc/g++, SM80+

upstream.source_usage: external checkout; no upstream source vendored or modified

cold_start.classification: process-first; cold only when supplied cache directories were empty

methodology.timed_region: one original upstream read or gated_write_read call; adapter region adds typed validation/dispatch only
methodology.excluded: allocation/reset, tensor generation, cloning, address generation, cache initialization, and synchronization before start; decode_cached intentionally preserves its preallocated state across calls
methodology.intrinsic_allocations: upstream output/workspace allocation remains inside because it is intrinsic to the frozen callable API
methodology.sampling: paired alternating AB/BA with raw wall and CUDA-event samples
methodology.training_timing: forward-only; backward certification is untimed and reported separately

semantics.address_layout: global int64 [parallel,sequence,width], strictly ascending and unique within token
semantics.mutation_order: decay -> retrieve -> delta -> scatter/write -> post-update read
semantics.collision_semantics: ordered across tokens; within-token duplicate addresses rejected
semantics.cache: memory mutated in place; sequence length committed after upstream return

backward_correctness.scope: compiler-visible write_scores/read_scores through product-key top-k, Softmax, and ordered state

float32.scope: write/read scores through product-key top-k, Softmax, and ordered state

input_generation.kind: deterministic random with rejection of product-key ties

bfloat16.scope: write/read scores through product-key top-k, Softmax, and ordered state

input_generation.kind: deterministic random with rejection of product-key ties

classification.basis: fixed case classification; percentages are paired device-median overhead

mature_kernel_gate.reason: descriptive external-anchor measurements; this SDM slice has no predeclared artifact eligibility decision for the mature-kernel gate

cpu_execution.reason: upstream kernels require CUDA on SM80 or newer

float16_state.reason: not in the frozen float32/bfloat16 adapter subset

duplicate_within_token.reason: upstream product-key routing is unique within a token; adapter rejects duplicate supplied traces

short_training_sequence.reason: pinned Triton training dot path requires sequence and effective chunk >= 16

unverified_revision.reason: adapter only dispatches the exact clean pinned upstream revision

write_bytes.reason: read-only path does not mutate sparse memory

traffic_estimate.notes: Counts logical sparse row traffic once per selected edge; cache reuse, write allocation, metadata, and kernel temporaries are not measured.

cache_persistence.reason: case is read-only or resets mutable state outside each timed region

call_identity.identity_basis: same stored object, bound instance, and function

oracle.reason: bounded oracle budget excludes this large/long case
